label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: path-injection confirmed. Resolved sink value at line 24 is "https://" + host + "/" + seg where host = request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest") (user-controlled) and seg = request.getParameter("seg") or default "home". The regex only validates host domain format but does not sanitize the path segment (seg) which flows directly into sendRedirect(), enabling path traversal attacks.

evidence.note: User input from BenchmarkTest parameter assigned to host, seg parameter flows to redirect URL without sanitization
